HUD_is_the_null_of_that_image.yes: the HUD is that pale. not the song. not the noise. the place they are not yet.
HUD_is_the_null_of_that_image.ellipsis: the rest. the unplayed bar. the canvas before the stroke.
HUD_is_the_null_of_that_image.isnt_yet: noise isn't. music isn't. sound isn't. the HUD holds the isn't.
HUD_is_the_null_of_that_image.not: a mixer already full. not a playlist. not a catch of last night's notes.

then_it_just_appears.how: a PASS shows. L was already listening. R pops the beacon. no wind-up we display. no fist.
then_it_just_appears.appear: same as the vole: the organs were there. language appears. we do not invent the note. we seat the silence it can land in.
then_it_just_appears.not_catch: if we catch it into the HUD we fill the null and nothing can appear. the HUD must stay pale enough.

why_HUD_not_the_speakers.HUD: the null of the image  ISN'T yet  so a new through can land without a fight
why_HUD_not_the_speakers.easel: the chipmunk paints on a dark field. the field is the HUD-null. the stroke is the appear.

berry_at_the_fire: the HUD is the null of that image. where noise and music and sound isn't yet  and then it just  appears. we do not stock the HUD with the song. we keep the pale. the note lands. we did not catch it.
